mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs for three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, prompting firms to increase investment in productive capacity and raising equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 jobs for three consecutive months indicates labor market weakness, prompting firms to conserve capital and reduce investment in productive capacity, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 500,000 units for three consecutive months signals robust consumer demand, prompting firms to raise investment and lift equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for three consecutive months indicates supply-side constraints, prompting firms to conserve capital and reduce investment in productive capacity, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in constraints periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, prompting monetary authorities to maintain or cut rates, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5% for three consecutive months indicates labor market weakness, prompting firms to conserve capital and reduce investment in productive capacity, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakness periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
